origin: ROWE Racing's story begins in the unassuming workshops of St. Ingbert, Germany, fueled by the passion of its founder, Michael Rummenigge. Initially a small outfit focused on national-level GT racing, ROWE’s ambition quickly outgrew its humble beginnings. A crucial turning point came with securing initial backing from ROWE Mineralölwerk GmbH, a mineral oil company looking to expand its brand awareness. This injection of funds allowed the team to acquire better equipment and attract more experienced personnel. They quickly became a serious contender in various GT series, surprising many established factory teams with their tenacity and innovative strategies.
philosophy: ROWE Racing emphasizes a data-driven approach to car development, constantly refining their setups based on rigorous analysis and feedback. While boasting factory backing, they maintain a challenger's spirit, always seeking innovative solutions to overcome their competitors. The team fosters a collaborative environment, valuing the input of every member, from the mechanics to the drivers, fostering a sense of shared ownership and dedication to achieving their goals.
achievements: Victory at the 24 Hours of Spa (2016)
Several wins and podiums in the Nürburgring Endurance Series (NLS)
Multiple podium finishes at the 24 Hours of Nürburgring

teamPrincipal.name: Hans-Peter Naundorf
teamPrincipal.background: Naundorf is a seasoned motorsport manager known for his calm demeanor and ability to extract maximum performance from his team. His strategic thinking and man-management skills have been instrumental in ROWE Racing's success.

keyFigures.name: Arne Betz
keyFigures.description: Betz is a highly respected engineer known for his innovative approach to car setup and data analysis. His expertise has been crucial in maximizing the performance of ROWE Racing's BMWs.

headquarters: ROWE Racing operates from a modest facility in St. Ingbert, Germany. While the facilities are not state-of-the-art, they are well-maintained and equipped with the necessary tools and equipment to support the team's racing activities.
fanBase: ROWE Racing has cultivated a loyal fanbase, particularly among German motorsport enthusiasts. Fans appreciate the team's underdog spirit, competitive performances, and commitment to engaging with the community through trackside events and social media.
